stem: The site team added UTM tags to the homepage banners that link to the sale page. Two weeks later a campaign called homepage_banner is the top source of purchases, and purchases credited to paid search fell. What most likely happened?

options.text: The tagged internal links started new attribution and overwrote the visitors' real sources
The banners drew buyers away from paid search, so the shift is a real change in their behaviour
Paid search clicks lost their gclid on the sale page, so GA4 filed them under the banner
The homepage_banner campaign became a key event, so GA4 now gives it the purchase credit
